title: Expedition Titles
description: An addon for the mod Levelplate that adds titles when traveling through biomes.
body:
![Expedition Titles NeoForge - Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cffb9233c15ab9a5c1bae0f63605ee9e06cb810_0.webp)

This mods add **simple titles on screen** when traveling biomes. It is designed to be used alongside [Levelplate](https://modrinth.com/mod/levelplate) and [Scaling Difficulty](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalingdifficulty)

![Expedition Title In Game Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c9d039d1d146eb492725ec5d8935392d69044f8_0.webp)

Also it adds the averge level of the mobs.

**Requires [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)**

This is a port of the mod [TravelerZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/travelerz) from Globox.

**It should be compatible with any biome from any mod**
